ChatSettings.description: Chat panel feature toggles. Omitted fields use their defaults.

allow_attachments.description: Show the paperclip attach button in the Chat panel. Default OFF.

allow_image_responses.description: Render image bubbles for media_batch AI replies. Default ON.

max_message_length.description: Max characters accepted per chat message. Default 2000.

session_persistence.description: Persist chat sessions to local storage across app restarts. Default ON.

show_branding.description: Show the "Built with Aerini" footer in the Chat panel. Default ON.

NodeType.description:
Palette category for a node type.

Controls which section of the node picker the node appears in.
Has no effect on execution behavior — the executor treats all categories identically.

RetryPolicy.description:
Per-node retry configuration.

The executor re-attempts a node that returns a *recoverable* failure up to
`max_attempts` times. Nodes returning an unrecoverable error are never retried
regardless of this setting.

backoff_ms.description: Fixed wait between attempts in milliseconds.

max_attempts.description: Total attempts allowed, including the first. `1` means no automatic retry.

WorkflowEdge.description:
A directed connection between two nodes on the workflow canvas.

The executor uses `from_port` to determine which edge to follow after a node
produces output. Multi-output nodes (e.g. `if_condition`, `switch`) write a
`branch` key to their output; the executor matches that value against `from_port`.

condition.description:
Optional expression evaluated by the frontend canvas to control edge visibility.
Not evaluated by the executor — routing is determined by `from_port` alone.

from_port.description: Output port name on the source node (e.g. "output", "on_true").

id.description: Unique ID for this edge (used by canvas to track connectors).

on_failure.description:
Target node activated when the source node fails after all retry attempts.
When set, the executor routes the failure here instead of aborting the run.

on_success.description:
Alternate target node activated when the source node succeeds.
Used by the graph builder to register additional reachability edges.

to_port.description: Input port name on the target node (e.g. "input").

WorkflowNode.description: One node instance in a workflow. node_type_id picks the node implementation and config holds its settings.

config.description: Static config for this node instance (filled in via the config panel).

credentials.description:
Named credential references (e.g. { "api_key": "openai_prod" }).
Values are credential IDs — the actual secrets are looked up at runtime.

disabled.description:
When true, the executor skips this node and activates its successors
as if it ran successfully with empty output. Existing workflows without
this field deserialize with disabled = false (fully backwards compatible).

fallback_node.description: Reserved for future use — not read by the executor in the current version.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema the node's input must match.

name.description: Human label shown on the canvas block.

node_type_id.description:
Which registered node IMPLEMENTATION to use (e.g. "http_request").
Multiple `WorkflowNode`s may share the same `node_type_id`.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema the node's output must match.

position.description: Visual position on the canvas — not used by the executor.

WorkflowSettings.description: Workflow-scoped feature settings. Currently holds only chat.

description: A workflow document: nodes, the connections (edges) between them, and workflow-level settings. A file with an older schema_version is migrated when it is loaded.

max_concurrent_nodes.description:
Maximum concurrent node tasks when `parallel_execution` is true.
`None` = use executor default (8). Reduce if hitting external rate limits.

max_duration_secs.description:
Maximum wall-clock time for the entire workflow execution.
`None` = no limit (backward-compatible default).
The executor clamps values to [10, 86400] seconds.

parallel_execution.description:
When true, independent branches run concurrently via the parallel executor.
Default: false — existing workflows are unaffected (sequential-safe default).
Enabling this for workflows with ordered side-effects (Stripe → Slack → Email)
may cause non-deterministic execution order; opt in only where branches are
truly independent.

settings.description: Workflow-scoped feature settings. Currently only the Chat panel toggles. Omitted fields use their defaults.

unlimited_duration.description: Only takes effect on a manual run started from the desktop app; scheduled and background runs ignore it. When true, the run ignores both the server duration ceiling and max_duration_secs.
